data.title: Journey of Rain and Clouds
data.introduction: Explore how liquid travels from the ground to the sky and back again through these key terms.

terms.definition: The process where liquid becomes a gas and rises into the air after getting warm.
terms.exampleSentence: Sunlight heated the puddle until evaporation made it disappear.
terms.clozeSentence: Sunlight heated the puddle until evaporation made it disappear.
terms.scenario: A wet sidewalk slowly dries up in the bright afternoon sun without anyone wiping it.

terms.definition: The change of a gas back into tiny liquid droplets when it cools down.
terms.exampleSentence: Cold water droplets formed condensation on the outside of the glass.
terms.clozeSentence: Cold water droplets formed condensation on the outside of the glass.
terms.scenario: Tiny water drops appear on the outside of a cold glass of lemonade on a hot summer day.

terms.definition: Any form of moisture that falls from the sky toward the ground.
terms.exampleSentence: Heavy precipitation forced the baseball game to be canceled.
terms.clozeSentence: Heavy precipitation forced the baseball game to be canceled.
terms.scenario: Children put on their rain boots and open colorful umbrellas as heavy drops begin hitting the pavement.

terms.definition: The gathering of fallen moisture into large bodies like lakes, rivers, and oceans.
terms.exampleSentence: The heavy rain led to the collection of water in the low-lying valley.
terms.clozeSentence: The heavy rain led to the collection of water in the low-lying valley.
terms.scenario: Streams of runoff water flow steadily down a hill to fill up a large blue lake at the bottom.

terms.definition: A substance in the form of a gas that floats invisibly in the air.
terms.exampleSentence: Hot steam rose from the kettle as invisible vapor.
terms.clozeSentence: Hot steam rose from the kettle as invisible vapor.
terms.scenario: An invisible gas rises into the sky from a warm cup of hot cocoa on a winter morning.

terms.definition: A large visible mass of tiny floating moisture drops high in the sky.
terms.exampleSentence: A fluffy white cloud drifted slowly across the blue sky.
terms.clozeSentence: A fluffy white cloud drifted slowly across the blue sky.
terms.scenario: Looking up, you see a giant, cotton-like gray shape blocking the sun before a storm.
